scope.import_subset: SEC32 UTF-8 regular files/directories, finite standalone loose-object format; no symlink/hardlink/special files, external gitdir/alternates, linked/bare, submodules or sparse/split index. No expansion from synthetic SEC33 parser records.
scope.dependencies: SEC31 whole-candidate helper/hook refusal retained; unknown dependencies/capture reject. Native hooks disabled additionally. Discovery is not confinement.

operation_abi.encoding: Version 1 length-prefixed strict UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid scalar types, depth >16 and trailing bytes before execution. One request per fresh process, serialized per candidate by trusted broker. Candidate registration is never a caller-supplied path.
operation_abi.path_policy: Nonempty unique list of UTF-8 relative literal paths; reject NUL, absolute, empty/dot/dotdot components, metadata paths and unsupported importer paths. Leading dash/pathspec-looking/tab/newline names remain literal. <=4096 paths, <=4096 bytes each, <=1MiB total; exact manifest identity required.
operation_abi.observation_authority: Only fixed status and ls-files --stage -z inside registered candidate; no generic read endpoint. Pre-add status supports existing preflight; index entries support per-call delta. Hash candidate manifest/index in trusted supervisor with bounded traversal, no diagnostic Git extensions. Native diff --cached --name-only -z --no-renames --no-ext-diff --no-textconv stays independent oracle only.
operation_abi.lab_difference: SEC30 permits status/add/write-tree only. SEC33 adds status and ls-files observations in lab. This packet proposes enumerated observation authority, does not retroactively authorize it. SEC31 config discovery is internal trusted validation over captured bytes in future implementation, not arbitrary Git config RPC.

response_abi.status_model: SEC33 lossless typed porcelain-v2 records, paths/header bytes hex; reconstruct native bytes exactly; validated 40/64 OID width from trusted registration; unknown/malformed records reject. Synthetic opaque/copy/unmerged parsing does not establish importer/native conflict acceptance.
response_abi.changed_paths: All staged changes versus HEAD, both rename sides, not limited to requested paths.
response_abi.index_changed_paths: Entry differences versus immediately before this call; restage can yield empty delta while all staged paths stay nonempty.
response_abi.identity: SHA256 raw index bytes (null if absent), SHA256 canonical SEC32/33 manifest identity including modes and exact bytes; trusted format selects tree OID width. No raw-index cross-run reproducibility claim. Successful stage returns actual new identity and invalidates old digest when bytes changed.
response_abi.enforcement: Count request before JSON allocation; incremental bounded stdout/stderr reads, count all discarded/truncated bytes, terminate on combined stream limit. Incremental parser caps records/path/output before allocation. Encoder reserves bounded failure envelope before serializing. Include request, supervisor manifests and serializer allocations inside memory budget; SEC33 captures before checking and proves none of this.
response_abi.failure_policy: No automatic retry or rollback claim. Before execution reject without candidate change. Once mutation may have begun, durably quarantine candidate before reply; retain actual index/manifest changes when provable. If observations cannot be obtained, identity_state=unknown with null current digests, persist last known digest separately, recovery_required=true. Never label old digest current. Missing response, crash, malformed output or exhausted budget cannot return success. No further Git for diagnostics after failure.
response_abi.overflow: Return bounded OUTPUT_LIMIT envelope with actual identities only if safely available; otherwise unknown identity + recovery_required. observations_omitted=true. Never include arbitrary full manifests in wire response; retain bounded supervisor evidence under candidate record. Local SEC33 manifest overflow behavior is not installed recovery.
response_abi.scalar_types: ok/execution_started/retry_automatically/recovery_required/observations_omitted/stderr_truncated are booleans; operation/candidate ID and phase/diagnostic/disposition are validated enumerated strings or registered ID. Digests are lowercase 64-hex or null only when explicitly absent/unknown; tree_oid is 40/64 hex from trusted format. exit/signal are bounded integer or null, stderr_hex even valid hex <=4096 decoded bytes. identity_state is known/absent/unknown; absent index is distinct from unknown. started=true conservatively if mutation cannot be ruled out. All response fields/schema and exact request correlation are checked by trusted supervisor before forwarding; startup with no registered candidate has null identities.

runtime_abi.installation: Separately installed supervisor/launcher/policy and minimal Git root filesystem in administrator-owned immutable location outside checkout, candidate and agent write reach. Reviewed manifest binds executable, loader, libraries, Git build, policy, ABI, root image digest and version. No use of PATH, checkout Python, editable plugins or host /usr fallback. Missing manifest hashes/platform enforcement reject RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE before candidate input.
runtime_abi.identity: Open verified runtime objects from protected directory identities, pin them through launch; validate ownership/modes and complete image digest. Reject rename/symlink/replacement/writable backing inode. Runtime updates require new manifest/review; an open FD number alone does not establish identity.
runtime_abi.launch_exec: A separately reviewed native launcher must demonstrate atomic transition from privileged setup to initial pinned Git execution and subsequent exec denial. Policy must distinguish initial launch from every execve/execveat (including AT_EMPTY_PATH), across threads/forks/ABIs, without reusable-FD exemption. No shell/interpreter/Git-child exception. Exact implementation and syscall policy are unresolved; fail closed until installed proof exists.

allowed: 0: bounded request pipe to trusted adapter; Git stdin is EOF
1: bounded response pipe; Git stdout is private supervisor pipe
setup-only: verified runtime and sealed bundle FDs consumed/closed before Git
fds.unexpected: Close all other inherited FDs; reject if enumeration/closure cannot be proved. No core/hostrun/UI/DB, host directory, device or socket FD; test SCM_RIGHTS and exec inheritance. CLOEXEC is defense in depth, not a proof of absence.

runtime_abi.input: Trusted supervisor accepts only registered content-addressed SEC32 bundle via read-only fully sealed regular input FD (write/grow/shrink/seal protections checked); validates bounded manifest and digest before extraction using descriptor-relative no-symlink traversal in broker-owned fresh root. No caller pathname resolution; no live import. FD seals do not solve hostile parent directories, trusted capture or durable importer recovery.

writable: StageCandidatePaths private candidate index/objects and lock paths only
mounts.policy: Private non-propagating namespace, no writable host backing inodes, no parent directory exposure. Stage worktree/config/attributes/ignore/hooks/HEAD/refs remain read-only; exact per-directory write policy must allow ordinary index/object lock/rename semantics without config/ref/file writes. If kernel policy cannot separate these paths safely, reject; no broad .git writable fallback.

runtime_abi.environment: Construct from empty map: fixed locale and private empty HOME/XDG, no global/system config, no prompts/pagers/editors, fixed pinned Git, optional locks off for inspect; no caller GIT_*, LD_*, PATH, SSH, credential/agent/shell/socket inheritance. No credentials in response.
runtime_abi.descendants: Fresh operation cgroup and PID namespace, no capability to escape/join another group, no new privileges, no inherited ambient capabilities; deny network/mount/ptrace/namespace escape. Deny exec for all descendants and threads across native/compat ABIs. Unsupported architecture/syscall/runtime rejects, rather than silently omitting policy.
runtime_abi.resources: Proposed small finite subset: reject oversized bundle/candidate before launch, enforce aggregate memory and pids in operation cgroup, storage quota for candidate+scratch including objects/locks, stream count in supervisor. Include setup, traversal and response time in deadline. Missing hard enforcement rejects. These new 64MiB/16384 limits narrow compatibility and need review/native positive controls.
runtime_abi.cancel: On authenticated cancellation, deadline, EOF or supervisor failure: stop admission, durably mark in-flight candidate recovery_required, revoke capabilities, bounded 1s grace then kill whole operation cgroup, reap and prove group empty before terminal success/cancel. Descendant inability to terminate => RECOVERY_REQUIRED, keep candidate quarantined; never cleanup/reuse while writers survive. Crash restart reconciles in-flight records before requests.
runtime_abi.startup: Verify installed manifest/ABI/kernel capabilities, namespace/mount/FD policy, hard cgroup/storage/stream limits, durable operation/quarantine store and candidate digest before readiness. Any failure rejects RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE without Git launch or current-runner fallback; no product routing during B.
runtime_abi.durability: B requires isolated worker operation/quarantine records with fsync/atomic transitions and crash reconciliation, distinct from C hook grant store. SEC33 in-memory quarantine and SEC32 cleanup are insufficient. No implementation or restart proof exists.

probe_policy.integration: Run exact unchanged probes against their original paths and retain red baseline. New installed harness must preserve original schedules and marker-absence assertions; cannot pretend immutable copied candidate makes swapped=True. SEC13 original directly executes experimental launcher, so an additional reviewed adapter/harness is needed for installed path; pin separate adapter and exact unchanged source hashes. If a schedule/path cannot be exercised unchanged, record NOT RUN/BLOCKED, not PASS. Unsupported linked origins reject before execution but require separate boundary attack coverage using linked-origin hostile inputs plus native controls; rejection is not linked-operation parity.
probe_policy.native_controls: For every late clean-driver/config mutation use separate unguarded disposable ordinary/linked repositories, assert actual marker execution >=1 and expected status. Keep SEC13 ready/release after boundary setup, all replace/include/worktree/inplace mutations x ordinary/linked. SEC11 needs deterministic enumeration schedule and native marker control, not just successful status. Preserve same-source external canaries and original parent namespace identity.
